info.name: QR Restaurant API
info.description:
Covers every REST endpoint of the QR Restaurant app, including the error cases (400 / 404 / 409).

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner does this by default): the menu folders create a catalogue, a category and an item, Tables does CRUD on a table of its own and then starts a dining session at a free table, Orders places orders with that item and session, and Cleanup deletes everything it created.

Set `baseUrl` to your app (default http://localhost:8080).

Two things to know:
- The dining flow needs one AVAILABLE table. The run leaves two tables occupied: the one it creates for the CRUD checks (kept, because a table with dining history cannot be deleted) and the one it seats guests at.
- Ending a dining session and marking a table cleaned are UI-only, so free those tables on the staff screen (/staff/tables) before the next run if you run out of available tables.
